types.title: Record Types
types.label: Label
types.fields_locked: Fields are read-only while this type holds records.

filter_error.reindexing: That field is being reindexed right now and cannot be filtered on yet. Try again shortly.
filter_error.unsupported_op: That condition isn't supported for this field.
filter_error.not_indexed: That field isn't indexed, so it can't be filtered or sorted on.
filter_error.unknown: That field doesn't exist on this record type.
filter_error.bad_value: That value isn't valid for this field.

editor.data_help: Raw JSON for this record's fields. Switching back re-fills the form from it.
editor.conflict_title: This record changed while you were editing
editor.conflict_help: Someone else saved a change to this record since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, or overwrite it with what you have.
editor.schema_stale: Fields changed since this was saved
editor.confirm_purge: This cannot be undone. Delete this record permanently?

type_editor.key_immutable: The key can't be changed once the type is created.
type_editor.icon_help: The name of a lucide-react icon, e.g. "database".
type_editor.is_public_help: Exposes a read-only public API for this type's published records (design §10).
type_editor.allowed_roles_help: Leave empty to allow anyone holding "Manage record types". Selecting one or more roles narrows access to those roles as well.
type_editor.field_key_locked: Can't be changed after the field is created.
type_editor.field_indexed_hint: The single most consequential choice on this screen: filterable and sortable, at the cost of a write per save.

key_error.pattern: Must start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
key_error.duplicate: Another field already uses this key.

type_editor.conflict_title: This type changed while you were editing
type_editor.conflict_help: Someone else saved a change to this type since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, then reapply your changes.
type_editor.delete_help: Deletes this type and every record stored against it, including the trash. This cannot be undone.
type_editor.delete_confirm_description: This permanently deletes "{{label}}" and its {{count}} record(s) (live and trashed). Type {{count}} to confirm.
type_editor.delete_count_mismatch: That doesn't match. Type the exact number to confirm.
type_editor.referrers_notice: Other types still have a relation field pointing at this one:

fields.no_choices: This field has no choices yet.
fields.unknown_type: This field type ({{type}}) is not editable in this version.

form.no_fields: This type has no fields yet. Add some on its schema screen.

relation.no_target: This relation field has no target type configured.
